_about: Documented disagreements between the engine and the GiellaLT oracle, each settled against a second source (Wiktionary declension tables, which follow the Kotus types). 'engine' = the engine's form is correct; 'ignore' = the oracle form is not taught.

engineForms.tytär:pl.genitive:tyttärien: Wiktionary (Kotus 32*C): tyttärien / tytärten. GiellaLT generates weak-grade tytärien.
engineForms.tytär:pl.partitive:tyttäriä: Wiktionary (Kotus 32*C): tyttäriä. GiellaLT generates weak-grade tytäriä.
engineForms.tee:pl.genitive:teiden: Wiktionary: tee → teiden / teitten. GiellaLT analyses teiden only as tie.
engineForms.vihreä:sg.partitive:vihreätä: Wiktionary (Kotus 15): vihreää / vihreätä. GiellaLT lacks the -tA variant.
engineForms.lounas:pl.genitive:lounasten: Kotus 41 allows a rare -sten genitive (Wiktionary: vierasten rare, rengasten rare). Marked rare: accepted, not taught.
engineForms.tuli:pl.genitive:tulten: Wiktionary (Kotus 23): tulien / tulten. GiellaLT generates only tulien.
engineForms.asiakas:pl.genitive:asiakasten: Kotus 41 rare -sten genitive, as vierasten/rengasten. Marked rare: accepted, not taught.
engineForms.asukas:pl.genitive:asukasten: Kotus 41 rare -sten genitive, as vierasten/rengasten. Marked rare: accepted, not taught.
engineForms.opas:pl.genitive:opasten: Kotus 41 rare -sten genitive, as vierasten/rengasten. Marked rare: accepted, not taught.
engineForms.taivas:pl.genitive:taivasten: Wiktionary (Kotus 41/vieras): taivaiden / taivaitten / taivasten (rare), as vierasten/rengasten; cf. taivasten valtakunta.

engineSlots.veri:pl: Wiktionary lists the full plural of veri (veret, verten / verien, veriä, veriin); GiellaLT lacks most plural forms. veri is marked 'mass' (plural rare).
engineSlots.hiki:pl: Wiktionary writes the plural with an apostrophe after k-loss between identical vowels (hi’issä, hi’in); GiellaLT omits it. hiki is marked 'mass'.

ignoreMissing.vuori: GiellaLT also generates vuori 2 'lining' (Kotus 5: vuorin, vuoria). Our lexeme is vuori 1 'mountain' (Kotus 26).
ignoreMissing.kuori: GiellaLT also generates kuori 2 'choir' (Kotus 5). Our lexeme is kuori 1 'shell, peel' (Kotus 26).
ignoreMissing.lahti: GiellaLT also generates lahti 2 (Kotus 5*F). Our lexeme is lahti 1 'bay' (Kotus 7*F).
ignoreMissing.äiti: GiellaLT also generates a non-gradating paradigm (äitin). Kotus 5*F: äidin.
ignoreMissing.veri: GiellaLT generates extra vere- plural forms; see engineSlots.
ignoreMissing.hiki: GiellaLT writes hiissä without the apostrophe; Wiktionary: hi’issä.
ignoreMissing.kaunis: GiellaLT's generator also emits archaic/poetic forms (kauns, kaunihin, kaunisna). Every engine form is recognised.
ignoreMissing.kallis: As kaunis: archaic/poetic extras (kalls, kallihin, kallisna).
ignoreMissing.tytär: GiellaLT generates weak-grade plurals (tytäriä); Wiktionary/Kotus 32*C: tyttäriä.
ignoreMissing.myymälä: GiellaLT also generates myymäliin; Wiktionary: myymälöihin only.
ignoreMissing.lohi: GiellaLT also generates lohea; Wiktionary: lohta only.
ignoreMissing.vuohi: GiellaLT also generates vuohea; Wiktionary: vuohta only.
ignoreMissing.suomi: GiellaLT also generates a pankki-type paradigm (suomin, suomia). Kotus 2024 lists suomi only as type 7: suomen, suomea, suomeksi.
